purpose: Independent server-authoritative authentication session for one Account; distinct from DANTE business Session.

columns.name: auth_session_ref
columns.value_contract: UUIDv7 only; safe for correlation, never a bearer credential.

columns.name: secret_verifier
columns.meaning: SHA-256 verifier of the high-entropy raw session secret.
columns.value_contract: Exactly 32 bytes; raw session secret is never stored.

columns.name: authenticated_at
columns.meaning: Instant establishing the current ordinary authentication-age window.

columns.name: recent_auth_at
columns.meaning: Most recent authentication evidence usable by current recent-auth policy.

columns.name: last_user_activity_at
columns.meaning: Last authoritative foreground/user activity used for idle expiry.
columns.value_contract: Finite and >= created_at; background polling must not advance it.

columns.name: expires_at
columns.meaning: Server-authoritative end of the current authentication window.

columns.name: revoked_at
columns.value_contract: Null while not revoked; finite and >= created_at when revoked.

columns.name: revocation_reason_code
columns.meaning: Stable internal reason code paired with terminal revocation.
columns.value_contract: Null while not revoked; non-empty when revoked.

foreign_keys.name: fk_auth_session_account_ref_account
foreign_keys.semantic_reason: Bind session to authoritative Account state.

unique_constraints.name: uq_auth_session_secret_verifier
unique_constraints.reason: Prevent verifier aliasing; collision is a security/RNG anomaly.

check_constraints.name: ck_auth_session_chronology
check_constraints.expression_contract: isfinite(created_at) AND isfinite(authenticated_at) AND isfinite(recent_auth_at) AND isfinite(last_user_activity_at) AND isfinite(expires_at) AND authenticated_at >= created_at AND recent_auth_at >= authenticated_at AND last_user_activity_at >= created_at AND expires_at > authenticated_at
check_constraints.reason: Keep authoritative session timestamps finite and coherently ordered.

check_constraints.name: ck_auth_session_revocation
check_constraints.expression_contract: (revoked_at IS NULL AND revocation_reason_code IS NULL) OR (revoked_at IS NOT NULL AND isfinite(revoked_at) AND revoked_at >= created_at AND revocation_reason_code IS NOT NULL AND revocation_reason_code = btrim(revocation_reason_code) AND revocation_reason_code <> '')
check_constraints.reason: Revocation is terminally represented by a timestamp plus non-empty reason.

indexes.name: uq_auth_session_secret_verifier
indexes.reason: Indexed session-secret verifier lookup and uniqueness.

indexes.name: ix_auth_session_account_ref
indexes.reason: Account session enumeration/revocation and FK support.

state_history.current_binding: Current usability is derived from revocation, expiry/activity and owning Account state; no redundant mutable EXPIRED flag.
state_history.chronology: Session timestamps describe current security lifecycle, not a Domain event log.
state_history.immutability_policy: Identity/owner/secret verifier and creation evidence are immutable in M3-A; only bounded activity/revocation columns have runtime UPDATE.

lifecycle.retention: Bounded operational/security retention; exact cleanup retention closes in M7.
lifecycle.redaction: Raw session secret is forbidden; verifier is security-sensitive and never exposed to clients/logs.
lifecycle.delete_behavior: No runtime DELETE in M3-A; logout is terminal revocation.

obligations: M3-A real PostgreSQL schema, ACL, mapping and catalog proof
